entries.EXTREME_STAGE_CONDITION_ENEMY_HP: When the enemy tower's HP falls below %d%
entries.EXTREME_STAGE_PASSIVE_ext_pas_agi_0001: The ATK, DEF and HP of Agility-type Rangers participating in battle decrease by %N%.
